description: This file is a shell script used for retrieving OCSP responses from a Certificate Authority, managing OCSP stapling information for a leaf certificate, and performing related certificate validation tasks. It handles command-line arguments, interacts with OpenSSL to fetch and verify OCSP responses, and manages temporary and symlinked files for OCSP data.

methods.name: errexit
methods.description: Function to clean up temporary files and exit upon encountering an error.
